body:
The maintainer asked for this in chat on 2026-11-22, in his own words:

> issue; enhancement; support for tapered tooling like ball mills, roundover bits and similar, router style tooling.

Part of #3351. Refs #3351. Sub-issue 7 of the plan in #3351.

Depends on #3370
Depends on #3371
Depends on #3372

## What to do

This is slice 4 of the research in #895 (Q2 has the offsets and depths), plus V-Carve, Trace and Engrave.

1. 2D Chamfer (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer.rs`, door at `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:2301`): the real-tip radial offset `s = r_t + tip_offset` and the tip height, as in #895 Q2. Update the reach and flute doors. Keep the `EdgeBreak` on the model edge.
2. Deburr (`crates/motion/src/finishing3d/deburr.rs`, door at `generate.rs:1378`): the outward shift along the edge normal sum by `r_t` and the drop, as in #895 Q2. Refuse a non-sharp tip on a ridge whose normal sum is near zero, by name.
3. V-Carve: the depth at a half-width `w` is the height where the meridian radius is `w` (the inverse of `rho`). A sharp cone gives the depth of today.
4. Trace and Engrave: admit the tip-formed `Taper`. The centre rides on the line, so the path does not change. The simulation and the checks read the real tip.
5. Open the doors that #3368 closed, for these five kinds only.

## Rules

- `effort:max`: the toolpath changes (safety floor).
- A sharp `Taper` keeps identical toolpaths and goldens (pinned).

## Done means

- A flat-tip chamfer mill and a ball-tip V-bit chamfer a brick to the given width and depth with no gouge under `deviate` and `credit_breaks` (pinned).
- A flat-bottom V-carve of a letter cuts to the inverse-meridian depth (a new golden next to `v_carve_letter_l.cl`).
- Deburr with a flat-tip taper breaks a convex edge to its width (pinned), and refuses a roof ridge by name.
